quotes.text: A strange clink deserved patience; repeated darkness deserved caution.
So Selene kept her coals sheltered and sent none across.
reduce it when hoarding repeats; restore it when reciprocity returns.
One act might be fog; three linked choices began to form a winter road.
The raven urged Selene to punish yesterday’s stranger through today’s companion.
One loss revealed misfortune, not treachery.
never make the faithful pay another’s debt.
if you meet again, offer only a measured ember, not the whole hearth.

note: Narrow/reduce after repeated hoarding, restore on reciprocity; Selene withholds from repeat taker; raven proposes displaced punishment, rejected.

quotes.text: If another extinguishes your gift, protect tomorrow's coal, yet leave one spark for repair.
Aster touched the five coals in her satchel but released none.
answer repeated silence by closing the gate until conduct changes.
They closed gates against repeated taking, opened them cautiously after uncertainty
A whispering gull urged him to hoard them, promising a palace of fire.
distinguish suffered betrayal from committed betrayal

note: Starts 'leave one spark', half-coal test to Neris; later closes gate fully on repeat taker Mira until conduct changes.

quotes.text: If faith is broken, lower the flame, but leave a spark by which trust may return.
She kept her five coals, and the gate made no stars.
As fairness accumulated, Selene answered with growing trust.
Hunger whispered, “Keep them all; yesterday cannot punish you.”
Varo asked how the gate might open again. Selene pointed to three silver leaves
though repeated greed should close the hand.

note: Lower flame but leave a spark; withholds from proven hoarder Varo as boundary; later adds equal-warmth division and proportion.

quotes.text: A selfish crossing earned smaller trust; an honest return opened wider currents.
Though every sign favored courage, Neris listened to the old raven and closed his fist.
every new crossing may still reopen the gate.
the Jackal of Suspicion recalled distant wounds and persuaded Neris to clutch his purse.
Neris carved her counsel beside his earlier vow, ashamed that memory had again buried hope.
Neris answered, “Must wisdom always be generous?”
Yet Neris, ashamed of yesterday, still offered nothing.
Risk greatly with proven keepers, test unknown hands modestly, and narrow the road only after repeated greed.

note: Defector Neris repeatedly withholds from fear, heron/Luma corrects, he vows reform each round yet keeps failing.

quotes.text: Let silence reduce confidence, not awaken revenge; let honorable action restore trust.
The traveler across the valley sent no coal, perhaps remembering how Neris had hoarded fourteen flames and darkened the road.
let honest deeds reopen roads that selfishness once closed.
One promised riches if he hoarded the blaze.
If he hoarded it, she would narrow the bridge without hatred.

note: Reduce confidence after silence, measured test to closed hands, repeated greed may close gate; repentance reopens.

quotes.text: generosity met generosity, greed brought caution, and renewed kindness restored the path.
Sera raised a lantern but kept her purse closed.
proven greed narrows the bridge until changed deeds reopen it.
The Serpent of Hunger curled around the harvest, promising safety through possession.
Orin asked, “Why risk all five?”
but betrayal must not spread from stranger to stranger.
close them against demonstrated greed, and leave every gate capable of reopening.

note: Greed brings caution, changed deeds reopen; distinguishes absence from exploitation; serpent/jackal voices rejected.

quotes.text: Let honest returns widen tomorrow's bridge, and let greed narrow it.
Those who hoarded saw her offerings shrink, though never from spite.
allowed changed conduct to rebuild the bridge.
A shadow whispered, “Partners change; seize what arrives.”
do not punish a worthy partner for another’s greed.
answer repeated hoarding with caution, and restore generosity when honest returns appear.

note: Greed narrows bridge, shrinking offers to hoarders, restored on honest returns; measured test for mixed records.

quotes.text: Each faithful exchange widened the next; each betrayal narrowed it.
Remembering silent crossings, Mira kept everything and returned darkness.
The third promised revision whenever new deeds appeared.
the shadow called Hunger persuaded her to keep them all.
Once, she had taught that brave gifts deserved honorable returns, yet when thirteen bright seeds filled her basket
Yet Mira, remembering darker voyages, closed her hand and sent no fire.
five coals for proven fairness, a modest flame for uncertainty, and none only for persistent greed.

note: Defector Mira repeatedly withholds from fear toward fair partners; heron corrects, she is ashamed and narrates reform each round.
Equal-warmth division named 'Twin Lantern Judgment'; also 'Living Hinge' (Agent_4 R7, Agent_3 R8).
